requirement.statement: cozo-wiki SHALL expose LLM wiki tool metadata, JSON argument binding, storage option parsing, and named tool execution through a reusable .NET library package that can be used by CLI, MCP stdio, and future HTTP server integrations.

case.given: The MCP stdio server is started
case.then: The server SHALL return the same tool names and input schemas as before the extraction

case.given: A user invokes cozo-wiki call with existing kebab-case tool options
case.when: The CLI binds options into tool arguments
case.then: The CLI SHALL call the shared tool runner with equivalent camelCase arguments and print the same JSON result shape
